verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog docs describe enforcing access control at query time, table-level privilege grants, and auditing/lineage (databricks-docs-19, 38, 46, 56), but none of the evidence explicitly documents column-level masking policies or row-level filtering. A community comparison explicitly contradicts the fuller claim, stating Databricks security is 'just table level, only in SQL and Spark, none in R' versus Snowflake's table/column/row-level security and dynamic data masking (databricks-comm-9). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of column masking functions/policies, row-level security filters, and independent confirmation that these work in practice across a shared warehouse.
